rationale: Kaarel's background shipping robotics infrastructure (Boston Dynamics work) and ML matching systems complements Parth's hands-on experience testing hardware for Tesla's humanoid robot program—a potential bridge between ML-driven perception/control and real-world mechanical validation. At a hackathon focused on physical AI, they could explore how fast-iteration ML agents might accelerate hardware testing workflows or robotic decision-making, leveraging Kaarel's speed-to-ship philosophy and Parth's domain expertise.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet Parth Behani — you've both shipped in robotics (Kaarel on Boston Dynamics infra, Parth on TeslaBot hardware testing), and a hackathon collaboration could merge ML tooling with physical robot validation.
